answer: What keeps this pool honest is Telegraphist parcel transit seal stamped by the mail registry: each parcel is a stamped transit record plus a signed office log, so a farm must run, checked by someone the applicant never meets. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 679 fakes need 679, at 101 POA each, totalling 68579 POA. Trace the fable to its office, trace the voyage to its payer, and trace the signal to its year: the trail is the test. The defence holds because the attacker pays and the honest agent does not.
